notes.title: SoulGame Studio release Flash classics in the Swords & Souls Legacy Collection
notes.content:
The new Swords & Souls Legacy Collection from SoulGame Studio brings five Flash classics back with a Steam release.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/soulgame-studio-release-flash-classics-in-the-swords-souls-legacy-collection/

notes.title: Swords & Souls Legacy Collection is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[p]It's taken us a while to put this collection together.  Reviving and porting Flash games can be awfully tricky.  And upscaling all the games, when they weren't designed for it, caused many headaches.  But as long as you amazing folks enjoy, then it's all worth it.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189440/Swords__Souls_Legacy_Collection/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Game development can be a thankless job, and we don't usually highlight the people who make this stuff... please give some love to:[/p][list][*][p]Severin and Adrien, the duo behind SoulGame Studios and developers of these fantastic games[/p][/*][*][p]Antony, the Flash and AIR wizard who got the games all working again[/p][/*][*][p]Ivan, a legend at finding bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Alexander and Bri, handling marketing and social media efforts[/p][/*][*][p]Daniel, the big boss man of Armor Games[/p][/*][*][p]Thomas and Ferret, for their general support on odd tasks [/p][/*][/list][p]
And a huge thanks to you, for reading this, and supporting Flash and Indie games![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]-Tasselfoot, producer on this fun project[/p]

notes.title: Swords & Souls Legacy Collection LAUNCHING on July 22nd!
notes.content: [p]We've been quiet for a while, but for a good reason! That's right... we're releasing SOOOOON. How soon, you ask? July 22nd soon! The [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189440/Swords__Souls_Legacy_Collection/"]Swords & Souls Legacy Collection[/url] will be coming out in less than 3 weeks. [/p][p][/p][p]Get 5 amazing, classic games from SoulGame Studio for the low, low price of [b]$9.99[/b]. Get 10% off if you already own Swords & Souls Neverseen (or buy the 2 games together)! [/p][p][/p][p]The 5 games: [i]Swords & Souls[/i], [i]Rogue Soul 1 & 2[/i], [i]Soul Driver[/i], and [i]The Gentlemen[/i], are ported from Flash via Adobe AIR and are HD-ified from 4:3 to 16:9, have increased audio quality, (some) bug fixes, cloud saves, and achievements. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189440/Swords__Souls_Legacy_Collection/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Wishlist to get notifed when it launches later this month![/p]
